text:
Version 5.0 is our largest release in years. Most of the work went into three things: making it faster, cleaning up the internals, and making the project easier to maintain long term.

**Node 16 is no longer supported**
Node 16 has reached end-of-life, so 5.0 requires Node 18 or newer. That means we can use newer runtime features and remove a lot of old compatibility code.

**New router**
We rewrote the routing engine from scratch. In our benchmarks it's 2.3x faster than the old one. If your app has a large or deeply nested route tree, you'll see the biggest improvement, both at startup and on each request. You still define routes the same familiar way.

**Breaking changes**
There are 7 breaking changes. Most involve router configuration and middleware signatures, and a few deprecated APIs have been removed. The migration guide covers each one and shows before-and-after code.

**Codemod**
We wrote a codemod that takes care of most of the changes:

```
npx framework-codemod v5
```

After it runs, review the diff and test your app. Once you've upgraded, let us know how it went on GitHub.
